title: kell hozzá: What a Dish Needs

sections.title: Two pieces you already know
sections.content: kell ("is needed, is necessary") is from A1. hozzá ("to it") is the same lexicalized case-suffix pattern as vele ("with him/her") — just built on -hoz/-hez/-höz instead of -val/-vel. Put together, kell hozzá is the natural way to say what a dish needs.

items.english: How many ingredients does a recipe need?
It needs a lot of spice.

sections.content: mennyi ("how much/many") is straight from A1's shopping vocabulary — asking mennyi ... kell hozzá? works for any recipe question, not just this one.
